title: Soft perfect fit for queen with 2inch topper
text: Soft perfect fit for queen with 2inch topper. Wow I slept so well husband did as well. There of course was a few wrinkles no big deal. The sheets were so soft and comfortable didn't get to hot. I also have a 2 inch topper on bed. I do have a queen and when I bought topper bought queen sheets and didn't fit. These sheets fit perfect with deep pockets and they are king and I will be purchasing more love highly suggest.
